meta.name: email-quality-auditor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "audit an email program" or "is this campaign safe to send"; runs a typed 20-item SEND profile with authentication, consent, opt-out, and claim veto checks on own evidence. Not for building deliverability setup — use deliverability-qa; not for designing lifecycle flows — use email-sequence-designer. 邮件质量审计/EQS评分/发送前放行

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计邮件发送质量并生成EQS评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责邮件营销并需要发送前质量把关
copy.tagline_en: Audit email send quality and generate EQS score
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage email marketing and need pre-send quality checks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 20 项 SEND 标准审计邮件程序，检查认证、同意、退订、声明等，并给出评分和放行/阻止/需修复的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求审计邮件程序或询问某次发送是否安全时触发。也适用于检查认证、同意、投诉、频率、声明或归因。

say.text: 审计这个促销邮件，检查 DMARC、同意记录和退订。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整审计并报告结果。

say.text: 检查这个新闻通讯的发送前安全。
say.note: Claude 会评估认证、同意等关键控制项。

say.text: 对最近 90 天的邮件程序做 EQS 评分。
say.note: Claude 会计算 SEND 分数并给出详细报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits an email program against 20 SEND criteria, checking authentication, consent, opt-out, claims, etc., and produces a score with a verdict (ship/fix/block).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit an email program or whether a campaign is safe to send. Also when authentication, consent, complaints, frequency, claims, or attribution need checking.

say_en.text: Audit this promotional send for DMARC, consent events, and opt-out.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full audit and reports results.

say_en.text: Check this newsletter for pre-send safety.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates authentication, consent, and other critical controls.

say_en.text: Run an EQS score on the last 90 days of this program.
say_en.note: Claude calculates the SEND score and provides a detailed report.
